tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Competitor price and stock monitor: track product pages on any shop that publishes its price in structured data (schema.org, Open Graph or microdata) and get every price change and stock change by webhook (Slack, Discord, Zapier, Make, n8n) and RSS/JSON feed. Free for 5 products; price lookup API. T

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_page · Public sink: check_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_page · Public sink: check_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
